title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Frim Transportation Agreement with the City of Boston, Boston Public Schools (Phase IV).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therfore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 03-6)
